title: SEG Coverage Report
description: Schema for a CoverageReport document in the Safety Evidence Graph. Not a proof — evidence of a controlled process that is aware of its own incompleteness. Accompanies every evidence package regardless of whether proof generation succeeded or was refused. A clean proof run produces a report with no gap entries and overallStatus: ready. Immutable once generated.

id.description: Globally unique IRI for this coverage report. Form: {namespaceBase}/proof/{snapshotId}/coverage-report.

seg:overallStatus.description: Overall proof readiness status. ready: all Gate 2 conditions met, proof was generated successfully. pending: warnings exist but no hard blockers — proof was generated with caveats. blocked: one or more hard blockers, proof generation was refused.

seg:structuralGaps.description: In-scope requirements that are missing at least one verifies or implements edge. Each entry identifies the requirement and which edge types are absent.

seg:requirementId.description: IRI of the requirement with incomplete coverage.

seg:missingEdgeTypes.description: Edge types absent for this requirement.

seg:suspectLinks.description: In-scope strong-propagation edges that are not in active state. Each entry identifies the edge, its current state, and the responsible role for resolution.

seg:linkState.description: Current integrity state of this edge. Any non-active state blocks proof: pending (never affirmed, e.g. bootstrap), directlyOutdated, transitivelySuspect, doublyOutdated, or broken (an endpoint node no longer exists in its source repo and the link cannot be resolved by affirmation).

seg:responsibleRole.description: Role responsible for resolving this suspect link. Derived from edge type: refines → RequirementsEngineer, implements → SoftwareEngineer, verifies → RequirementsEngineer + TestEngineer.

seg:subHashChanged.description: Optional diagnostic indicating which sub-hash changed on the source node.

seg:staleOutcomes.description: In-scope test outcomes whose seg:repoBSha does not match the current HEAD of repo B. These outcomes were produced against an older implementation state and the test suite must be rerun.

seg:outcomeId.description: IRI of the stale TestOutcome node.

seg:recordedSha.description: The repo B SHA recorded in the TestOutcome node. 40 hex chars for SHA-1 repos, 64 for SHA-256 repos.

seg:currentSha.description: The current HEAD SHA of repo B at proof generation time. 40 hex chars for SHA-1 repos, 64 for SHA-256 repos.

seg:missingOutcomes.description: In-scope test specifications that have no corresponding test outcome in the specified test run. Each entry is a gap in execution coverage.

seg:testSpecId.description: IRI of the TestSpecification node with no outcome in the test run.
